title: Pgvector VectorStore adapter
description:
Create chatbot/memory/pgvector_store.py implementing the VectorStore abstract interface from chatbot/memory/vector_store.py.

Implement PgvectorStore(VectorStore) with:
- Constructor takes an async SQLAlchemy session (AsyncSession) and an optional table reference (defaults to a configured table, e.g., SemanticFact or a dedicated vector_items table — use the SemanticFact model's embedding column for storage)
- add(): INSERT vectors with metadata using pgvector's <-> cosine distance operator compatible insert
- search(): SELECT with ORDER BY embedding <-> query_embedding LIMIT top_k, return SearchResult list
- delete(): DELETE by id filter, return rowcount
- count(): SELECT COUNT(*) from the backing table

Import and subclass VectorStore from chatbot.memory.vector_store. Import models from chatbot.db.models. Use session.execute() with sqlalchemy text/select constructs. Handle empty results gracefully.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task c.5)
- chatbot/memory/vector_store.py (produced by task c.3)
- chatbot/db/models.py (produced by task c.2)
- chatbot/db/session.py (produced by task c.1)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: All five abstract methods (add, search, delete, count) are implemented
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add third-party dependencies beyond sqlalchemy and pgvector
